The 2nd Annual G.U.F.F. fundraiser is tomorrow!!!! True Timbers is wonderfully hosting us and @[61579408484436:2048:Pour Decisions Co LLC] is coming with  their tournament exclusive G.U.F.F. drink!! 

  This doubles tournament is to raise funds for graceandpeacerva.com , a nonprofit that supports our poorest and endangered families right here in Richmond. 

  Online registration is closed but you can still pay at sign up tomorrow! Lots of fun prizes!  Details in the attached flyer!! 

Thanks to @[100042034766923:2048:Fly High Sports] , @[100064902605827:2048:Prodigy Disc] , @[100066902446390:2048:River City Disc Golf], and all of our local sponsors!!

If you're still on the fence about coming to the G.U.F.F. charity tournament this weekend True Timbers take a look at the prize pool! Sling Bottle, a local Richmond company, has donated some of their water bottles. And Par Saver wants to help us train with their Snap Trainer!! It's still evolving but here's what we have planned so far : 

1st Place - 2 @[100064902605827:2048:Prodigy Disc] bags with rain flys, a Firebird and a Hawkeye disc, 2 disc stencils,( possibly more to come!)

2nd Place - 2 Glow Lab Fireflys, 2 NEW Halloween glow Buzz discs, 2 disc stencils, ( possibly more to come!)

3rd Place- 2 @[100064902605827:2048:Prodigy Disc] Landing Pads, 2 disc stencils, Disc -TBD, ( and possibly more to come!) 

There will also be 9 CTP prizes that include disc stencils, Legends of the Chains cards, Sling Bottle, $25 Tree Magnets G.C. , $50 @[100063824611755:2048:Third Eye Richmond] G.C., and discs! 

Once again we will have a raffle basket which you can see below being put together with lots of goodies. Tickets will be $10, Well worth the value!! 

So register your team and come have a great time !! 

https://www.discgolfscene.com/tournament/2nd_Annual_GUFF_Fun_Raier_2026

Disc golf random draw doubles at my house Saturday 10/17/26...$7 gets lights for all your normal discs and entry into 7 different payout pots. THIS IS A FUN  SOCIAL EVENT OPEN TO ALL SKILL LEVELS. Two rounds of PAR-2 (36 holes, average 65 feet each) and one round of PAR-3 mini (9 holes) = 45 total holes. BRING A DRINK OR TWO, AND JOIN US AROUND THE FIRE FOR SOME GOLF, MUSIC, AND FUN. ....Be registered by 7:30PM.....Say "IN" below for all who will attend....608 Woodford Street 22401

Hey everyone! I have a couple openings left for my full day, disc golf seminar in Richmond. Message me for details.

I also have a few upcoming dates in North Carolina. Message me for that info as well :-)

Cooling Pond Opener Cooling Pond Brewery • Mineral, Virginia

2 rounds of 18 with lunch break. Tee time 11, gates open at 10. $20 open, $10 everyone else. $5 greens fee included. Sign up through Udisc, pay cash day of.

4 Days!!!!  Just 4 days left to register for the 2nd Annual Guff Charity Doubles tournament!!  

   This event is to raise funds for Grace &Peace Community Ministries, a non-profit that does amazing work for the poorest of RVA!! ( graceandpeacerva.com ) .

   Swag bags are ready!! Prizes are sorted!  Distance Championship prize pack is set!  All we need is you!!  So come on out and have for a good cause, share an amazing drink from @[61579408484436:2048:Pour Decisions Co LLC] , grab a cool swag bag with gifts and coupons, and share some fun and laughs with your friends!

2026 Spotsy Club Championship Saturday December 12th at Loriella Park!!!

1 round of stroke play followed by match play in each division to determine the winners. Must have been a club member on October 1st 2026 to be eligible. Pro/FPO/MA1/FA1/MA2/MA3/MA4

We will be having a potluck lunch between rounds. The club will start the food off with some dominos pizzas and Biscoe BBQ so please sign up for some side dishes.

Details are being finalized and registration will open tomorrow so be on the lookout for a DGS link to the event.
